name: access-certificate-discovery-revisit

protocol.note: Phase D revisit of E004 (ADR-035, ADR-036). Does not overwrite experiments/definitions/E004-access-certificate.json -- that B-era row's degenerate full-arena DiscoverThenLease scan is historical. Four-node pointer chain stored as 12-byte PointerRefs in allocation bytes (load_ref wire layout); seed at node 0 reaches 2 nodes; Universe on the same Arena is 4. Host walk / host round-trip is HostAssisted, never DevicePass.

correctness.tolerance: exact (discovered reference count strictly less than Active Universe count; certificate covers the discovery witness; forged extra allocation refused; topology_epoch bump mid-walk refused)

judgement: Phase D revisit: DiscoverThenLease now walks a caller-supplied seed topology (02 §7.2) and can certify a reachable set strictly smaller than Universe on the same Arena (2 of 4 on the 4-node chain; isolated seed 1 of 4). The walk is a host read of 12-byte PointerRefs and a host round-trip, honestly classified HostAssisted -- never DevicePass, and never an OS page-migration claim (semantic reachable set / proxy; 06 §10). Certificate covers the discovery witness; a forged extra allocation is refused; a topology_epoch bump mid-walk is refused. SoftwarePaged/FaultManaged stay Unsupported. B-era E004-access-certificate.json is not rewritten. Break-even vs full-arena scan is unmeasured (two ratios only). Vulkan is compile-review-only per ADR-024/ADR-035/041.
vulkan_status: compile-review-only (ADR-024/ADR-035/041); vulkan_device_hal.cpp documents the HostAssisted host-walk mapping and does not execute discovery
